systems.name: seed
systems.role: Harness floor: run records, tool identity, provider adapters, the shared contracts
owns: run contracts and the records an agent leaves behind
tool identity and registry entries
provider adapters and the model ladder
budgets and the autonomy policy record
the shared contracts every other system builds against

systems.name: capillary
systems.role: Context: bounded retrieval with sources attached, and relations
owns: context pulled in from every route the person turns on
bounded packets that keep their sources attached
relations between what the agent knows and where it came from
by-reference context instead of copies

systems.name: myosotis
systems.role: Memory: consent to keep, structural forget
owns: consent to keep a memory, recorded before it is kept
structural forget that removes the memory, not just the view of it
per-agent memory scope
epoch-stamped projections so a forget cannot be undone by a stale read

systems.name: drosera
systems.role: Tools: tool faces, skills, hooks, cookbooks
owns: tool faces and how a tool is offered to an agent
skills, hooks, and cookbooks
the connector broker for opt-in context routes
the tool faces a paired companion exposes

systems.name: aestivation
systems.role: Review and delegation: plans, verdicts, questions to the person, the assembly gate
owns: plan validation before work starts
verdicts on finished work
questions to the person, each linked to the setting that caused it
the assembly gate that holds work back
holds on actions triggered by untrusted content

systems.name: bloom
systems.role: User interface: the desktop and web app, first-run setup, the head agent; the only composer
owns: the one place a person raises and runs an agent
first-run setup and the settings each step points to
the head agent and its character
the questions inbox and the pairing screen
the desktop app and the web app shells

systems.name: trellis
systems.role: Testing from outside the call path: shape, behavior, consistency, operational probes
owns: shape, behavior, consistency, and operational probes
a family grid runner that tests the pinned tree from outside
setup and pairing probes for the app
